title: Neelkanth: Zeher Peeke Duniya Bachai! 🔱
tagline: Samudra Manthan mein Shiva ne Halahala vish piya
verified_fact: In the Samudra Manthan (churning of the cosmic ocean), deadly Halahala poison emerged. Shiva drank it to save the universe. Parvati stopped it at his throat, turning it blue — giving Shiva the name Neelkanth (blue-throated).
voiceover_script: Devas aur Asuras ne milke samundar mantha — amrit ke liye. Lekin pehle nikla Halahala — duniya ka sabse khatarnak zeher. Ek drop se poori srishti nasht ho sakti thi. Tab aage aaye Mahadev. Bhole Nath ne wo zeher khud pee liya. Parvati ne haath se rok diya unka gala. Zeher neela pad gaya — aur tab se Shiv ka naam pada Neelkanth. Kya aisi kurbani aaj bhi possible hai?
debate_question: Aisa koi hai jo duniya ke liye khud ko sacrifice kare?
pinned_comment: 🔱 Neelkanth! Duniya ke liye zeher piya Mahadev ne. Har Har Mahadev!
description:
Neelkanth: Zeher Peeke Duniya Bachai! 🔱

🔱 Samudra Manthan mein Shiva ne Halahala vish piya

In the Samudra Manthan (churning of the cosmic ocean), deadly Halahala poison emerged. Shiva drank it to save the universe. Parvati stopped it at his throat, turning it blue — giving Shiva the name Neelkanth (blue-throated).

👉 Aisa koi hai jo duniya ke liye khud ko sacrifice kare?
